label: Stellantis: Fiat 500e (2020+, BPCM at 0x18DA44F1/0x18DAF144). e-CMP models (Peugeot e-208/e-2008, Opel Corsa-e/Mokka-e, Citroen e-C4, DS3 Crossback E-Tense, Jeep Avenger) have no public decode.

ecu.notes: 29-bit addressing for the Fiat 500e battery pack control module, from the OBDb Fiat signalset (CC BY-SA 4.0). pack_voltage is read from a different module (0x6B4/0x694). e-CMP CAN addressing is not publicly documented.

fields.notes: OBDb Fiat_HVBAT_ST_CHG: HV battery state of charge. Fiat 500e (2020+) per the OBDb Fiat signalset.
OBDb Fiat_HVBAT_SOH: HV battery state of health. Fiat 500e (2020+) per the OBDb Fiat signalset.
OBDb Fiat_HVBAT_CURRENT: HV battery current. Fiat 500e (2020+) per the OBDb Fiat signalset.
OBDb Fiat_MAX_CELL_V: Highest cell voltage. Fiat 500e (2020+) per the OBDb Fiat signalset.
OBDb Fiat_MIN_CELL_V: Lowest cell voltage. Fiat 500e (2020+) per the OBDb Fiat signalset.
OBDb Fiat_MAX_CELL_T: Highest battery temperature. Fiat 500e (2020+) per the OBDb Fiat signalset.
OBDb Fiat_MIN_CELL_T: Lowest battery temperature. Fiat 500e (2020+) per the OBDb Fiat signalset.
OBDb Fiat_HVBAT_VOLT: High voltage battery voltage. Fiat 500e (2020+) per the OBDb Fiat signalset.

notes: e-CMP requires a special 16-pin OBD adapter cable to expose the diagnostic CAN. Community apps (Car Scanner) include SOH, SOC, battery temperature, per-cell V and module temperatures, but no open-source repository publishes the per-DID byte map. OVMS Github issue #719 tracks an unfinished port. See https://github.com/openvehicles/Open-Vehicle-Monitoring-System-3/issues/719 .

unavailable_fields.e_cmp: e-CMP (Peugeot / Opel / Citroen / DS / Jeep) fields are not documented at byte level in any open public source.
unavailable_fields.cell_voltages: No public per-cell decode for the Fiat 500e.
